### Bio:

I work with Dr. Suchard on improving analytics on observational healthcare data as part of the Observation Health Data Sciences and Informatics (OHDSI) community. My research focuses on propensity score methods and large-scale patient prediction models. These analytics are typically conducted through scalable packages in R and sometimes Python. In my free time, I like spending time with my dog and playing the guitar.
